identity.normalization: strip whitespace, remove leading @, lowercase; numeric id is metadata only
identity.invalid_account_policy: fail except explicitly recorded exclusions; quarantine missing keys
identity.duplicate_account_policy: fail; never silently select a row

source_rule: Use 19K observations for both labeled and unlabeled users; labels only from annotated. Do not fill missing 19K features from annotated. Report source coverage and disagreements. Observation windows remain unverified.

quality_exclusions.1193634420000993280: Previously documented malformed account row with repeated ID values across unrelated fields; not a modality exclusion.

split_origin.policy: Copied once for explicit preservation; runtime never reads legacy final_data. Validate key/label coverage; fail instead of silently resplitting.

missingness.temporal: No estimated temporal values. Canonical NaNs retained; fit each scaler on finite observed training values; zero placeholder only after scaling with per-feature observed masks. Entire absent temporal branch must be gated out.
missingness.non_temporal_numeric: Training median before log1p and robust scaling; retain per-feature observed masks.
missingness.binary: Training most-frequent observed value; ties choose 0; retain observed masks.
missingness.no_training_observations: Disable feature, zero numerical placeholder, feature_enabled=0; preserve schema.
missingness.invalid_values: Report and mark negative nonnegative measurements, infinities, and parse failures missing; never silently clip.

graph.split_rule: Gold-owner graphs contain only same-split gold endpoints; support/external users may overlap across graphs. Unlabeled-owner graph excludes validation/test gold endpoints. This is not a fully node-disjoint split.
graph.has_graph: Owner has an observed valid neighbor list and at least one retained incident edge in the permitted graph. Node membership and owner availability also exported separately.
graph.global_edges_role: Audit/provenance only, not an authorized training graph.
graph.self_edges: Exclude from model edges and count; keep no fabricated edges.

text.normalization: HTML unescape; NFKC; Arabic/Persian character normalization; URL and mention placeholders; whitespace; preserve hashtags/emojis
text.token_length_origin: Retained historical setting; no tokenizer/model download or new held-out tuning in preprocessing.
text.deduplication: Within-user exact normalized text, newest first; validation excludes train texts; test excludes train and cleaned validation texts. Preserve user rows even if all tweets removed.
text.has_text: Usable tweet text OR usable description; component masks remain separate.
text.description_source: Raw description if nonblank, otherwise provided clean_description; record source; do not substitute a description embedding for a tweet embedding.

definition_changes.followers_friend_ratio: Preserve followers/friends when friends>0 and followers when friends==0. Missing/invalid denominator now remains missing instead of falling through to followers.
definition_changes.description_length: Preserve raw character count for observed descriptions, including observed empty strings. Missing raw description now remains missing instead of becoming length zero.
definition_changes.name_digit_counts: Preserve Unicode isdigit counts on observed strings; missing source now remains missing instead of zero.
definition_changes.url_in_description: Same regex; missing raw description now remains missing instead of 0.
definition_changes.invalid_negative_values: Mark invalid and report, rather than clip.
definition_changes.feature_selection: Fixed historical 40-feature design, not a new full-data selection procedure. Historical test reuse remains a limitation.
